subject: LumosAI onboarding: payment cadence and QuickSettle early-pay option

Subject: LumosAI onboarding forms + payment terms question

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for walking us through the Redwood onboarding last week. Attached are the completed onboarding payment details and our signed PO acceptance form for the first pilot batch. A couple of quick questions so we can align with your AP process: 

- What is Redwood's standard payment cadence for new suppliers (Net 30/45/60)?
- Are early-pay programs available (we were quoted a 1% discount during the demo) and what are the eligibility steps?

We'd like to be set up on a Net 30 cadence if possible, but we can accept Net 45 depending on your procurement policy. We will also need the final Redwood PO number to reconcile our invoicing.

Attachments: LumosAI_Onboarding_Payment_Details.xlsx, LumosAI_PO_Acceptance_Form.pdf

Best,

Hi Elena — thanks for sending these over and for the clean PO form. 

Quick answers up front:
- Redwood default for new vendors is Net 45.
- We do have an early-pay program (QuickSettle) that offers a configurable discount in exchange for accelerated payment; eligibility is usually confirmed by Finance and Supplier Ops.

Can you confirm: is LumosAI requesting Net 30 as a firm requirement for the pilot, or would Net 45 + QuickSettle (15-day, 1.5% discount) be acceptable? If you prefer Net 30, I can escalate but will need Procurement + Finance signoff.

Kimberly — can you start the supplier onboarding checklist and confirm whether the PO form is complete from a fields perspective (tax ID, remittance bank details, W9 on file)?

Thanks,
Mina
Vendor Onboarding Manager
Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-06T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: LumosAI onboarding forms + payment terms question

Mina / Kimberly — looping in Finance notes and the recommended approach.

- Standard onboard = Net45. We keep Net45 as baseline to maintain predictable cash flow during ramp.
- QuickSettle option: Finance can support a 15-day early-pay program at 1.5% discount for strategic partners. That requires: (1) signed QuickSettle addendum, (2) verified bank details and tax docs, (3) PO number tied to the invoice.

If LumosAI needs Net30 instead of Net45, I can provision an exception for the pilot but would like Procurement to record a one-time Net30 exception (expires after 90 days) — please note this could delay activation while we get approval.

Recommendation: Offer LumosAI Net45 with an opt-in to QuickSettle (15d / 1.5%). It is usually the fastest path to payment acceleration without special approvals.

David Kim
Head of FP&A
Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@lumosai.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-09T08:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: LumosAI onboarding forms + payment terms question

Elena — thanks, and apologies for the slight delay while we coordinated internally.

Quick summary / decision: 
- Redwood will onboard LumosAI on Net 45 (company default).
- We are pleased to offer LumosAI the QuickSettle early-pay option: 15-day payment with a 1.5% discount, subject to submission of final tax & bank docs and signing the QuickSettle addendum.
- If LumosAI requires Net 30 as a mandatory term, we can evaluate a one-time Net30 exception for the pilot (approval required; may add 2–4 business days).

Action items for LumosAI:
1) Please resend the completed PO acceptance form adding your legal entity tax ID and remittance bank details (we did not receive the W9 in the spreadsheet). If you are a US entity, attach the W9; if not, attach the equivalent tax registration.
2) Reply to confirm whether you accept QuickSettle (15d / 1.5%). If yes, I will send the QuickSettle addendum and a DocuSign link.
3) Confirm the contact to receive the PO number internally so we can route invoices correctly.

We aim to issue the PO within 48 hours of receiving the completed docs and the signed addendum (if you opt in).
